notes: The manuals of every version spell the component quantities xvelocity, xdragforce, xpresgradient, ypregradient, ...; live, all of 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 accept only the suffixed forms - including the engine's own typo 'pregradient-y' for the y pressure-gradient component (presgradient-y is rejected).
The extra history takes no index keyword here ('Unused extra parameter (index)'), unlike the ball/clump cfd histories.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): every suffixed quantity (including pregradient-y) created by id, position and name on all three consoles; the manual's x-prefixed spellings and presgradient-y rejected on all three; quantity set confirmed against the engine's own keyword enumeration.
